title: A compatible algebra tensor model becomes a pushout on a directed tail
statement: Let I be a directed preorder and F:I→CommRing a diagram with colimit cocone (C,ι) [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix i∈I, finitely presented F(i)-algebras A,B [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and an F(i)-algebra map f:A→B. Let P,Q be commutative rings with a P-algebra structure on Q, P finitely presented over Z and Q finitely presented over P. Write A_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i)}A, B_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i)}B, X=C⊗_{F(i)}A and Y=C⊗_{F(i)}B. Suppose a P-algebra structure on X and a ring equivalence e:X⊗_P Q≃Y are given, with e restricted to X equal to the tensor extension of f. Then there are k≥i and ring maps q_j:Q→B_j for every j≥k such that (1) the coprojection B_j→Y composed with q_j equals e composed with the right inclusion Q→X⊗_P Q; (2) every transition B_j→B_l sends q_j to q_l, for k≤j≤l; (3) for every j≥k there is a P-algebra structure on A_j such that the P-structure on B_j through f_j:A_j→B_j agrees with the one through q_j, and the square P→A_j, P→Q, A_j→B_j, Q→B_j is an algebra pushout. All tensor structures are induced by transitions of F; the coprojections are induced by ι. No module is part of this statement.

proof.text: Use the finite-stage descent statement to obtain k above i, qk, its prescribed image in Y, and the pushout square at k. This is only the finite-stage part of the argument, not the tail statement.

For each j above k define qj=(F(k to j) tensor id_B) composed with qk. Cocone naturality and tensor-map composition show that qj has the prescribed image in Y. Functoriality F(k to j) followed by F(j to l)=F(k to l) and tensor-map composition prove compatibility qj to ql. These are the two explicit ring-hom equalities in the Lean proof.

Apply pushout preservation under scalar extension with R=F(i), S=F(k), T=F(j), t=F(k to j), and the original f. The resulting Q-map is definitionally qj and its pushout conclusion is precisely the third clause.

theorem exists_tensor_model_algebra_tail
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    {i : I} {A B : Type w} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) A] [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) A]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) B] (f : A →ₐ[F.obj i] B)
    (P Q : Type x) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q]
    (aP : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A))
    (e : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* (c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B)
    (he : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (c.pt : Type v) (c.pt : Type v))
          f).toRingHom) :
    ∃ (k : I) (hik : i ≤ k),
      ∃ q : ∀ (j : I) (hkj : k ≤ j),
        letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj))).hom.toAlgebra
        Q →+* (F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B,
      (∀ (j : I) (hkj : k ≤ j),
        letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj))).hom.toAlgebra
        letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) :=
          (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        let t : F.obj j →ₐ[F.obj i] c.pt :=
          { (c.ι.app j).hom with
            commutes' := fun s ↦ ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
              (c.w (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj))) s }
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map t (AlgHom.id (F.obj i) B)).toRingHom.comp
          (q j hkj) = e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom) ∧
      (∀ (j l : I) (hkj : k ≤ j) (hkl : k ≤ l) (hjl : j ≤ l),
        letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj))).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkl))).hom.toAlgebra
        let t : F.obj j →ₐ[F.obj i] F.obj l :=
          { (F.map (homOfLE hjl)).hom with
            commutes' := fun s ↦ (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj)) (homOfLE hjl)) s).symm }
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map t (AlgHom.id (F.obj i) B)).toRingHom.comp
          (q j hkj) = q l hkl) ∧
      (∀ (j : I) (hkj : k ≤ j),
        letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj))).hom.toAlgebra
        let D := (F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A
        let E := (F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B
        let d : D →+* E :=
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (F.obj j) (F.obj j)) f).toRingHom
        letI : Algebra D E := d.toAlgebra
        letI : Algebra Q E := (q j hkj).toAlgebra
        ∃ aPj : Algebra P D,
          letI := aPj
          letI : Algebra P E := (d.comp (algebraMap P D)).toAlgebra
          letI : IsScalarTower P D E := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
          ∃ hPQ : IsScalarTower P Q E,
            letI := hPQ
            Algebra.IsPushout P D Q E)
